headline: Cyberattack Cripples Production at AGVSS with Major Operational Impact
body: Autoliv Guangzhou Vehicle Safety Systems Co., Ltd. (AGVSS) announced it has suffered a significant disruption due to a ransomware assault on its digital infrastructure and factory systems. Several production lines at the Guangzhou site have been temporarily suspended as a result. The cybersecurity team is making efforts to restore normal operations, amid concerns that crucial business documents might have been compromised. Security measures are being enhanced to ensure a swift recovery of the affected systems.
